# Goldscrew PZ Double-Countersunk Thread Cutting Multipurpose Screws 5mm x 50mm 200 Pack(16497)

(5209)

Ask a Question

Top quality, waxed single thread, multipurpose screw. Popular with the professional. Features a lower screw-in torque and faster drive speed. Suitable for screwdrivers, combi drills and impact drivers.

*   Double-Countersunk Head for Reduced Shear
*   Carbon Steel Construction
*   Zinc-Plated & Yellow-Passivated
*   Wax-Coated
*   Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
*   Fully Threaded
*   For Wood, Plastic, Masonry & 1mm Sheet Metal
*   Heat-Treated for Snap Resistance
*   Corrosion-Resistant
